enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Breathe steadily. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm. Turn onto back. Snore. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Take bowl from cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Pick up mug. Pour coffee from pot. Add milk. Stir. Drink coffee. Stand up. Place bowl and mug in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work scrubs and packing bag for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out scrubs. Take off pajamas. Put on scrubs. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Place stethoscope in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Check phone for time. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into work shoes. Put bag in locker.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care, monitoring vitals and completing clinical documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at unit. Receive handover report. Check patient charts. Enter patient room. Wash hands. Check patient vitals. Record vitals. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Adjust IV. Assist patient with mobility. Document in computer. Attend team meeting. Talk to doctor. Update care plan. Respond to call light. Assist colleague. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to unit. Continue patient care. Complete documentation. Give handover to next shift.

Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to house. Open door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Take cutting board. Take knife. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the kitchen, washing dishes and wiping counters
enriched_activities.desc: Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Pick up sponge. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Drain sink. Wipe counters with cloth. Wipe stove. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Replace trash bag. Wash hands. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and changing into comfortable clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Put on comfortable clothes. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust sitting position. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Sit down. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for continuing education and checking schedules
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Navigate to continuing education website. Read article. Take notes. Check schedule. Close browser. Shut down computer. Close laptop. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brushing teeth, washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face. Dry face. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Turn onto back. Stretch arms. Turn onto other side. Pull blanket up. Remain asleep.
